newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Four killed in Colombian grenade blast.
newsitem.headline: Four killed in Colombian grenade blast.

text.p: Four men were killed in a rural area of southwest Colombia when a hand grenade they discovered in a field exploded while they were toying with it, police said.
They said the accident occurred on Thursday in the small town of La Vega, in a guerrilla-infested region of Valle del Cauca province, about 215 miles (350 km) southwest of Bogota.

In other developments, military spokesmen said at least three soldiers were killed in fighting with Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC) rebels late Thursday in northwestern Antioquia province.
The troops killed were on a counterinsurgency sweep through a mountainous area near the town of Frontino, they said.
The Marxist FARC, Colombia's largest and oldest guerrilla group, was founded in 1964.
